facts.fact: The World Bank concept-stage PID for Digital Eswatini says back-end interoperability frameworks are currently underdeveloped and that a robust whole-of-government interoperability framework led by the Ministry of Information, Communication and Technology is needed, with no framework stated as drafted; dated by the document's own preparation date, 28 June 2025.

facts.fact: The IOM assessment (mission October 2022) says Eswatini has processes in place for a government interoperability framework (GIF) and recommends concrete steps on the submitted GIF proposal and its timely approval by the cabinet, so it was a submitted proposal and not yet adopted.

The Office of the Executive Secretary, e-Governance published the Eswatini e-Government Interoperability Framework v1.0 (cover January 2025), with a publishing date of March 2025, setting technical policies and standards for how government systems interconnect and exchange data.
